subject: Post-webinar attendee triage + priority routing playbook
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Webinar — attendee export + proposed triage rules

Thanks team — great turnout yesterday (1.1k registrants, 420 live attendees). Attached is the cleaned attendee export and a first-pass priority matrix. Highlights and asks below:

- Attachments: 20270214-webinar-attendees.csv (full export), priority-matrix-v1.xlsx (scoring logic), session-recording-link.txt (internal recording URL)
- Proposed MQL rules (first-pass):
  * Score +3 for "Company size > 200"
  * Score +2 for "Attended live"
  * Score +2 for "Asked product/ops question in Q&A"
  * Score +1 for "Requested follow-up"
- Routing buckets by score:
  * 7-9 -> AE outreach (direct handoff)
  * 4-6 -> SDR priority queue (1 business day SLA)
  * 0-3 -> Nurture sequence only

Please review the scoring weights and confirm SDR assignments. Our goals: (1) call top AEs within 48 hours for 7+ leads, (2) SDRs to triage and book demos within 24 hours for 4-6, (3) add low scorers to a 6-week nurture.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Quick notes from SDR ops:

- I like the 7-9 -> AE handoff but suggest raising "Asked product/ops Q" to +3 (those are the warmest).
- Add +2 for "Company in target verticals: FinServ / Healthcare / AdTech" so we don't miss smaller but strategic logos.
- For routing: propose SDR rotations by region + vertical (see mapping below). If a lead is 7+ but indicates "Procurement timeline: Q2" put AE and SDR both on the thread and mark for next-touch priority.

Proposed SDR -> AE mapping (short):
- Ben Carter (NA Financials / FinServ) -> AE pool A
- Vivek Kulkarni (NA Large Tech & Platform) -> AE pool B
- Tessa (EMEA & APAC overflow) -> flag only (I'll reassign as needed)

I'll take point on configuring the HubSpot list & workflows today. Can Ben and Vivek confirm they can cover follow-ups Monday (2/15) morning PST? I will upload the filtered hubspot list and share the sequence.

Tessa Morgan
